correctness.rationale: Over a finite triangle-free parameter graph G in the countable homogeneous Henson H_3, an injective ordered r-tuple outside the parameters is specified by a labelled triangle-free F on r coordinates and r parameter-neighbor sets. Mixed triangles are absent exactly when these choices form an independent set of G □ F. This proves T_r(G)=Σ_F i(G□F) (r fixed >=2). For a bipartite B with b vertices, pad G=B⊔E_m with m=3(rb+binom(r,2)+2): the edgeless F contributes i(B)^r 2^(rm); all other F contribute less than 1/4 after normalization using (3/4)^m and the 2^(rb+binom(r,2)) count bound. Flooring one exact oracle output and taking its exact r-th root retrieves #independent sets of B by polynomial metric reduction. The same class lies in #P by guessing tuple incidence bits and checking K3-freeness. The E_m spectrum and second exponential rate follow from independent-set counts of F with zero, one, and ≥2 edges. Independent direct enumeration confirms 99 product, 21 edgeless-profile and 22 padding instances; finite checks are not the proof for all r,G.
